title: Let the Bani cool what is burning
summary: Exhaustion becomes harsher when you keep performing strength instead of receiving help. Keep this close: Hold onto this: read the Bani again until the inner heat cools.
takeaway: Return the tired body to refuge before asking more of it.
lifeApplication: Before pushing harder, name what this body can honestly carry today and receive the help already near.

source.shortMeaning: The Lord's Bani cools the heart like nectar taken in again.
source.lifeApplication: When the inside is burning, take the line in again before reaching elsewhere.
